title: Finitely presented closed zero locus of an affine finite-free sheaf map
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], $M,N$ structure-sheaf modules with $M\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus s}$ and $N\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and $d:M\to N$. There is a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], such that every morphism $h:T\to X$ factors through $i$ if and only if the ordinary pulled-back sheaf morphism $h^*d$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is zero.

source.place: proof: the subscheme cut out by the finite matrix-entry ideal

proof.text: Choose the supplied free frames. Identify free sheaf morphisms with finite matrices of global sections using freeHomEquiv and freeSectionsEquiv. Form the ideal I spanned by the finitely many matrix entries; its finite generation is Submodule.fg_span.

Construct Z as Spec(Gamma(X,O_X)/I) and i as the quotient spectrum map followed by X.isoSpec.inv. Surjectivity gives a closed immersion. RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_surjective and LocallyOfFinitePresentation.SpecMap_iff give local finite presentation from finite generation of I.

Pullback carries the free frames to free frames. freeMatrix_pullback identifies the new matrix with the entrywise global-sections map. Its vanishing is equivalent to I lying in the kernel of h.appTop.

A factorization annihilates I by the quotient map and naturality of GammaSpecIso. Conversely, Ideal.Quotient.lift constructs the ring map from the quotient, and T.toSpecGamma followed by Spec of that map constructs the factor. The identity follows from toSpecGamma naturality and the affine isoSpec identity. This works for arbitrary nonaffine T, empty matrices and zero rings.

proof_origin.place: proof: the finitely generated matrix-entry ideal and its quotient spectrum
proof_origin.note: Fully proved in Lean using the explicit ideal quotient, freeMatrix_pullback and the Spec/global-sections adjunction for arbitrary source schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineFreeMapZeroLocus
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) (d : M ⟶ N) (s n : ℕ)
    (hM : Nonempty (M ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hN : Nonempty (N ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X),
      IsClosedImmersion i ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation i ∧
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ X),
        (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = h) ↔ (Modules.pullback h).map d = 0
